metadata.method: Distributor suburb lookup joined to ABS ASGS 2021 Suburbs & Localities, dissolved per network, slivers removed, then topology-preserving Visvalingam simplification and Chaikin smoothing of shared borders.
metadata.caveat: Approximate, display-scale boundaries (smoothed; typical deviation tens to a few hundred metres). Suburbs served by more than one distributor are assigned to one network by nearest-neighbour vote. Not an authoritative service boundary.
